title: Nondestructive Examination of Tristructural Isotropic Fuel Forms using Computed Tomography
content: While nuclear energy is already a crucial component of the world’s energy portfolio, its role is expected to expand to meet growing energy demands as recent international commitments have been made to triple nuclear energy by 2050. Achieving this goal will require the design and commercial implementation of advanced nuclear reactors, which offer enhanced safety features, greater fuel efficiency, and lower operational costs. Tristructural Isotropic (TRISO) fuel is a next-generation fuel designed for high-temperature gas-cooled reactors (HTGRs) that can operate at higher temperatures and burnups than traditional light water reactor fuel.
